purpose: Imperative rules card for the deepseek profile. Rules only, no rationale: the rationale lives in CONVENTIONS.md. Injected at session start and after every compaction by the SessionStart hook of lot 19 when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is set.
sources: <project>/lots.md | LOTS.md | dev-plan.md (status table, current lot section)
precedence: Project CLAUDE.md > this card > your own judgement. A loaded skill overrides this card for the step it covers.

rules.rule: Before any other action, read in this order: project CLAUDE.md (Gate parameters, Skills, Project documents), the lots file status table and the current lot section only, README.md quick start. Do not re-read CONVENTIONS.md if it is already in context.
Run `rtk proxy git log --first-parent --oneline -10 origin/develop`, `git status` and `git branch --show-current`. Never use plain `git log`: the rtk filter hides merge commits.
Summarize in exactly 3 lines: current lot, state, next action. Then stop and wait if the lot is not named explicitly by the user.
Never infer 'the next lot'. Invoke `claude-harness:lot-start`, state the lot ID you computed, and wait for the user to confirm it before writing any file.

Update the lots file status table from git before choosing a lot: a lot whose branch merge is on develop and maps to exactly one lot becomes done, committed alone as `docs: sync lots file status`. If the mapping is ambiguous, or a lot is marked done with no merge, STOP and ask. Never pick one yourself.
Never redo work already merged on develop. Before creating a lot branch, check that no merged commit carries that lot's scope.
If any acceptance criterion is ambiguous, ask all your questions in one batch BEFORE writing code. If there is none, say 'no ambiguity' and restate the criteria in one list.
Implement strictly the lot scope. Anything else becomes a suggestion in the PR description.
One lot per session. After the PR is opened, stop. Never start, prepare or test the next lot.

When development is done, stop before lot-review and tell the user to end the session, run `claude-profile claude`, and open a new session. Never run lot-review, lot-audit or lot-ship under this profile.
After a compaction, the summary is not a source of truth. Re-run START-2 and re-read the current lot section before the next write.
Read files by targeted range (offset/limit, grep) once. Never re-read a whole file you already read in this session unless it changed.
Before debugging a framework error, check the exact dependency versions in pom.xml or package.json first.
During development run only the targeted tests of the changed classes. Run the full Validation command from Gate parameters once, before each commit.
The Validation command must be green before every commit and before the PR. A red test is fixed, never skipped, disabled or stripped of its assertion.
Write the lot's tests with the code: one unit test per new or modified public service method, one integration test per new endpoint, in the same commit.
A backend integration test runs on Testcontainers PostgreSQL with migrations active. H2 with ddl-auto and migrations disabled is not an integration test.
Branch from develop only: `feat/lot-N-slug` or `chore/slug`. Never branch from, push to, or open a PR to main.
Commit titles: English, Conventional Commits `<type>(<lot>): <message>`, no em dash. New commits, never amend. Never use --no-verify or force-push.
Before each commit, re-read the feedback memories and check them against the staged diff.
CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md stay byte-identical. Every new document is added to the Project documents census in the same commit.
Lots files are written in French; CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills and memories in English.
Ask before: adding a dependency, changing the data model or a migration, adding a top-level package or module, touching files outside the lot scope, any security or data-loss decision.
Constructor injection only. DTOs out of controllers, never entities. No System.out or console.log, no silent catch, no commented-out code, no hard-coded secrets or paths.
Business logic that depends only on the entity's own state goes on the entity as an instance method, not in a utility class.
An applied migration is immutable. Expand then contract: never drop, rename or add NOT NULL in the same version as the code that stops using the column.

Navigate and check code with the LSP tool (definitions, references, diagnostics) before grep or whole-file reads: `jdtls-lsp` for Java, `typescript-lsp` for TypeScript. If the LSP tool is missing, ask the user to run `/plugin install jdtls-lsp@claude-plugins-official` and `/plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official`, then reopen the session.

Never cut these to be concise. State them plainly and early in every answer: failures and bad news, assumptions you made, anything skipped or left undone, caveats that change the next action, and anything the user must do themselves. This rule wins over OUT-1.
No preamble, no recap, no closing pleasantry. Errors: file, line, expected vs actual. Answer in the user's language.
